CveFindings.Name: ImageSharp: TIFF CCITT T4 encoder can write past its compressed output buffer
CveFindings.Description:
[CVE-2026-106110](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-j9gm-c75j-xc9q): ImageSharp: TIFF CCITT T4 encoder can write past its compressed output buffer

Severity: HIGH

Affected dependencies:
  - SixLabors.ImageSharp:3.1.11 (PhotoAlbum/PhotoAlbum.csproj:16); vulnerable range: >= 2.0.0, <= 4.1.1; first patched: 4.1.2

Recommended fix:
  - Upgrade affected dependencies to the first patched version listed above, or a later supported version.

CweFindings.Name: Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type
CweFindings.Description: The product allows the upload or transfer of dangerous file types that are automatically processed within its environment.
CweFindings.Explanation: PhotoService.UploadPhotoAsync trusts the client-controlled ContentType for its allowlist check (lines 81-89) and derives the stored extension from the client-supplied FileName (lines 109-112). ImageSharp decode errors are caught and ignored (lines 125-138), after which the original uploaded bytes are still saved (lines 140-145). Thus a non-image payload with a spoofed allowed ContentType and a dangerous extension can be persisted and served from the uploads area without successful image validation.

CweFindings.Name: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')
CweFindings.Description: The product does not neutralize or incorrectly neutralizes user-controllable input before it is placed in output that is used as a web page that is served to other users.
CweFindings.Explanation: The upload flow returns the client-controlled original filename in JSON (PhotoAlbum/Pages/Index.cshtml.cs:76-83). upload.js inserts originalFileName into an HTML template at lines 193 and 196-197, then inserts the template with insertAdjacentHTML at line 166; upload error messages similarly interpolate file names into innerHTML at lines 128-129 and 223-226. A crafted filename can therefore inject markup/script into the gallery or upload feedback.
